description: This file implements a CSS tokenizer in TypeScript, defining token classes, utility functions, and the main tokenize function for parsing CSS strings into tokens.

classes.name: CSSTokenInterface
classes.description: Interface for CSS tokens with methods toSource() and property value.

classes.name: InvalidCharacterError
classes.description: Error class for invalid characters in tokenization.

classes.name: HashToken
classes.description: Token class for hash tokens, with type 'id' or 'unrestricted'.

classes.name: DimensionToken
classes.description: Token class for dimension tokens with units.

classes.name: EOFToken
classes.description: Token class for end of file.

classes.name: CSSParserToken
classes.description: Base class for CSS tokens with common properties.

classes.name: GroupingToken
classes.description: Base class for grouping tokens like brackets and parentheses.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Main function to tokenize a CSS string into an array of tokens.

methods.name: escapeIdent
methods.description: Escapes a string for use as a CSS identifier.

methods.name: escapeHash
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in hash tokens.

methods.name: escapeString
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in CSS string tokens.
